device_template.name: Seplos BMS V2 pack (ASCII protocol, read-only)
device_template.author: Stefan Maldaianu
device_template.description: One Seplos V2 battery pack read over its RS485 ASCII protocol (CID1 0x46), protocol seplos_v2 (a serial port on this host) or seplos_v2-tcp (a serial bridge's raw TCP port). READ-ONLY: the driver only encodes the read commands 0x42 (telemetry), 0x44 (alarms) and 0x51 (identity); nothing on the pack can be changed. NOT YET VERIFIED ON HARDWARE — built from the published V2.0 protocol; the bench confirms or corrects it. Set unit_id to the pack address (ADR, the pack's DIP switch). connection.mode: poll (the gateway is the master and asks this pack) or listen (passive: it decodes a master pack's exchanges and never transmits). NEVER POLL A BUS WHERE A MASTER PACK ALREADY POLLS (the inter-pack bus of a multi-pack bank): listen there. Rows read the driver's fixed virtual map, so one template serves 15- and 16-cell packs; a value the pack does not report stays absent. Field names follow seplos_bms_v3_rtu_tap wherever the meaning is the same, so dashboards carry over.

notes.text: Not yet verified on a real pack: the decode follows the published Seplos V2.0 protocol. Check the values against the pack's own display or BatteryMonitor before relying on them.

On a multi-pack bank the master pack polls the others on the inter-pack bus: choose Listen only there. A V2 master asks its slaves only with the 0x5A summary, which this map does not read: use seplos_bms_v2_tap for them. Poll only a bus with no other master (a single pack, or the master's own RS485 port with nothing else on it).
The alarm bit names follow the V2.0 telesignalling table. Alarm Event 1–8 and Switch State are the raw bytes, kept so the bench can check every bit.
